name: EXM_VAT_FIELDS
description: This table contains tax data capture rules by territory for tax purposes.

columns.name: VAT_SETUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a tax rule for a specific territory.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ENABLE_MERCHANT_NAME_CODE
columns.description: Display behavior of merchant name field for this territory in an expense report.

columns.name: ENABLE_MERCHANT_RECEIPT_CODE
columns.description: Display behavior of receipt number field for this territory in an expense report.

columns.name: ENABLE_MERCHANT_TAX_REG_CODE
columns.description: Display behavior of tax registration number field for this territory in an expense report.

columns.name: ENABLE_MERCHANT_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: Display behavior of merchant reference field for this territory in an expense report.

columns.name: ENABLE_MERCHANT_TAXPAYER_CODE
columns.description: Display behavior of taxpayer identification field for this territory in an expense report.

columns.name: ENABLE_TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Defines the behavior of the tax classification code field in expense entry. Valid values are Hidden - the field is not displayed in expense entry, Optional - the field is displayed in expense entry and is an optional field to be entered by the user, Required - the field is displayed in expense entry and is a required field to be entered by the user.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether tax fields are displayed on an expense report.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
